title: cypripedium calceolus subsp. parviflorum
intro: Cypripedium calceolus subsp. parviflorum, commonly known as the small-flowered lady's slipper orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce pain and swelling. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions, such as stimulating digestion and relieving gastrointestinal issues, due to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the properties and effects of Cypripedium calceolus subsp. parviflorum, and its use should be approached with caution due to potential toxicity and side effects.
